sources.title: Moonshine · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: Moonshine is an encoder-decoder speech recognition model optimized for real-time transcription and recognizing voice commands. Instead of using traditional absolute position embeddings, Moonshine uses Rotary Position Embedding (RoPE) to handle speech with varying lengths without using padding. This improves efficiency during inference, making it ideal for resource-constrained devices.

sources.title: moonshine: Audio-to-Text model — overview, use cases, alternatives
sources.snippet: Overview moonshine is an automatic speech recognition (ASR) model designed for transcribing English speech audio into English text, developed by moonshine-ai. The model exists in two sizes: a 27-million parameter tiny variant and a 61-million parameter base variant, both built with a sequence-to-sequence architecture and released in October 2024.
